_source: Embedded fund expense ratios per asset and year range for c_eff = max(c - embedded_fee, 0) on CommissionUse=True rows. Built 2026-10-02 from the Portfolio Visualizer FAQ proxy-fund periods (https://www.portfoliovisualizer.com/faq) and the provenance in docs/data_audit_findings.md. Years not covered by a period have embedded fee 0 (gross index, price, or synthetic/research data). Each fund uses one current expense ratio (stockanalysis.com, fetched 2026-10-02) for all its years: this is an APPROXIMATION, because historical expense ratios were often higher, so the embedded fee in early years is understated. Values of the 2024-2025 ETF proxies that were not corrected in data/data_corrections.json have their own period.

Bitcoin.notes: Gross: BTC price (upmyinterest.com/bitcoin; 2024-2025 Slickcharts). No fund fee inside the return.

Commodities.notes: PV proxy GSG for all years (PV FAQ); 2024-2025 corrected to GSG. Single current ER applied to all years (approximation).

Emerging Markets.notes: PV proxy VEIEX from 1995; 2024-2025 corrected to VEIEX. Current ER; historical ERs were higher (approximation).

European Stocks.notes: 1986-1990 AQR Europe MKT factor (gross); VEURX from 1991 (PV FAQ); 2024-2025 corrected to VEURX. Current ER 0.23 (Vanguard N-CSR FY2016 showed 0.26; earlier years were higher) - approximation.

Global Bonds Unhedged.notes: PV proxy Loomis Sayles Global Bond Instl (LSGBX) for all years; 2024-2025 corrected to LSGBX. Active fund; current ER (approximation). Note embedded fee 0.67 exceeds the assumed commission 0.30, so c_eff = 0.

Global ex US Stock Market.notes: After correction this is PV Global ex-US: 1970-1985 MSCI World ex USA gross, 1986-1996 AQR Global ex US MKT factor (gross), VGTSX from 1997 incl. 2024-2025. Current ER 0.17 (FY2016 N-CSR showed 0.19) - approximation.

Gold.notes: Gross: gold price from upmyinterest.com/gold in all years, including corrected 2024-2025 (27.2 / 64.6). The PV/GLD gold column is not used by LazyReturns1.

Intermediate Term Treasury.notes: 1972-1991 FRED 5-year constant-maturity synthetic (gross); VFITX from 1992 (PV FAQ); 2024-2025 corrected to VFITX. Current ER (approximation; historically ~0.20-0.28).

Intl Developed ex US Market.notes: 1986-1999 AQR Global ex US MKT factor (gross); VTMGX (Admiral) 2000+ per PV FAQ. 2024-2025 values are still the refresh proxy VEA (not corrected); VEA ER 0.03 as stated on the VTMGX page. Current ERs (approximation; VTMGX history was higher, ~0.07-0.22). [uncertain: PV may have used a different share class in early years]

Long Term Corporate Bonds.notes: PV proxy VWESX for all years; 2024-2025 corrected to VWESX. Current ER (approximation; historically ~0.21-0.32).

Long Term Treasury.notes: 1978-1986 FRED 30-year synthetic (gross); VUSTX from 1987 (PV FAQ); 2024-2025 corrected to VUSTX. Current ER (approximation).

MSCI World ex USA index.notes: Gross: MSCI World ex USA gross index in all years after correction (2024-2025 = 5.26 / 32.55 from the MSCI gross factsheet).

NASDAQ100.notes: Gross: NASDAQ-100 total return from upmyinterest.com/nasdaq100 in all years, including corrected 2024-2025 (25.88 / 21.0).

REIT.notes: Gross: Dow Jones Select Real Estate Securities index from upmyinterest.com/us-real-estate in all years, including corrected 2024-2025 (8.0 / 4.4). The PV REIT column (VGSIX) is not used.

S&P 500.notes: Gross: S&P 500 total return (Damodaran / official S&P) in all years.

Short Term Treasury.notes: 1977-1991 FRED 2-year synthetic (gross); VFISX from 1992 (PV FAQ); 2024-2025 corrected to VFISX. Current ER (approximation).

TIPS.notes: VIPSX from 2001 (PV FAQ). 2024-2025 values are still the refresh proxy TIP (not corrected). Current ERs (approximation).

Total US Bond Market.notes: VBMFX from 1987 (PV FAQ). 2024-2025 values are still the refresh proxy BND (not corrected). Current ERs (approximation; VBMFX was ~0.20 in the 1990s-2000s).

US Large Cap.notes: 1972-1976 Kenneth French research data (gross); VFINX from 1977 (PV FAQ); 2024-2025 corrected to VFINX. Current ER 0.14 (approximation; VFINX was ~0.18-0.20 in the 1990s-2000s).

US Large Cap Value.notes: 1972-1992 Kenneth French research data (gross); VIVAX from 1993 (PV FAQ). 2024-2025 values are still the refresh proxy VTV (not corrected); VTV ER 0.03 as stated on the VIVAX page. Current ERs (approximation).

US Mid Cap Value.notes: 1972-2006 Kenneth French research data (gross); VMVIX from 2007 (PV FAQ). 2024-2025 values are still the refresh proxy VOE (not corrected). Current ERs (approximation).

US Small Cap.notes: 1972-1989 Kenneth French research data (gross); NAESX from 1990 (PV FAQ). 2024-2025 values are still the refresh proxy VB (not corrected); VB ER 0.03 as stated on the NAESX page. Current ERs (approximation; NAESX was ~0.20-0.30 historically).

US Small Cap Value.notes: Gross: Paul Merriman small-cap-value research series via upmyinterest.com/small-cap-value for 1928-2023 [exact underlying index uncertain, no fund costs]; 2024-2025 = upmyinterest's MSCI US Small Cap Value index values 8.8 / 10.7 (confirmed 2026-10-02 at https://www.upmyinterest.com/small-cap-value/, which states 'For the year 2024 and forward, we use the MSCI US Small Cap Value Index'). Index, so no fund fee [uncertain whether upmyinterest uses the gross, net or price variant]. The PV/VISVX series (US_Small_Cap_Value_Monthly) is NOT this series.
